subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the sender-enrichment budget is fixed, should this branch become the canonical Mattermost thread-history recovery fix, and is one bounded inbound server fetch per stored session acceptable?
rationale: The bug and implementation layer are clear, but maintainers must choose between open candidate PRs and explicitly own the session-state and availability tradeoff in the Mattermost inbound path.

options.title: Fix Lookup Budget Then Land This Candidate
options.body: Cap or remove per-post user lookup delay, refresh against main, and use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Pick The Sibling Candidate
options.body: Fresh-review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 instead if maintainers prefer that implementation shape, then close this PR as superseded after the sibling merges.

options.title: Pause For Owner Direction
options.body: Hold both candidate PRs until a Mattermost/session owner chooses the permanent recovery semantics and fetch budget.

recommendation.title: Fix Lookup Budget Then Land This Candidate
recommendation.body: Cap or remove per-post user lookup delay, refresh against main, and use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the Mattermost plugin path and the shared inbound history/session behavior recently refactored in the same area.
